data.narrative:
Renaissance Fusion is a Series A nuclear energy company founded by Francesco Volpe and Martin Kupp, having raised $60.5M to date. The valuation universe comprises 11 peers across nuclear energy: 3 public companies (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private firms including Fuse Energy, X-Energy, Oklo, Nano Nuclear Energy, and General Matter.

Stage-progression methodology is applicable here, using total capital raised of $60M as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $121M. Peer-median analysis is not executable: while 4 same-sector peers exist, insufficient datapoints meet narrow filtering criteria (same stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier)—the dataset contains only 1 same-stage comparable and 1 adjacent-stage peer, falling short of the 3-point minimum needed for robust median derivation.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $103M to $139M, with a median point of $121M. This range reflects conservative ($103M, -15% haircut) to moderate upside ($139M, +15% step) around the single applicable method. Key uncertainties include the thinness of true peer comparables at this stage within nuclear energy, precluding validation via multiple triangulation methods, and the reliance on raised capital as a valuation proxy absent disclosed financials or revenue. A follow-on Series A or Series B raise would provide market-derived pricing to anchor future analysis.
